title: D2 TKMessage wire-shape spec
description: Schema for contracts/tk-message/tk-message.spec.json — the source-of-truth catalog of JSON property-name constants that govern the cross-language TKMessage wire shape ({key, params?}). D2.Shared.WireShapes.SourceGen reads it to emit TkMessageWireShape into D2.Shared.I18n.Abstractions; tools/ts-codegen/src/tk-message-emit.ts reads it to emit tk-message.g.ts into @d2/result. The .NET TKMessageJsonConverter and the TS-side parser reference the spec-derived constants for JSON property names — wire-format drift on 'key'/'params' is structurally impossible.

properties.description: Closed catalog of TKMessage wire-shape property-name constants. Each entry pins one JSON property name (e.g. 'key', 'params').

constName.description: Public C# / TS constant identifier — UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Must be unique across the spec.

value.description: Wire-format JSON property name emitted on the TKMessage JSON object (e.g. 'key', 'params'). Must be unique across the spec.

doc.description: XML <summary> / JSDoc text rendered on the emitted constant.
